For all sufficiently small epsilon a finite state set independent of epsilon is forward invariant. Exact expansion of the two-step kernel yields I+epsilon Q+O(epsilon^2) with the claimed nonnegative rates; Q has one closed irreducible class I_c. Finite compactness and stationarity force total-variation convergence to its uniquely balanced probability. Reflection symmetry, all support threshold equalities and c=1/2 product weights are independently reconstructed. The included check.py passed exact rational transition, stationary mean and balance checks. Limits: no convergence rate nor uniformity over unbounded c.
